snippet.title: Apocalypse Express - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
We are happy to announce that Apocalypse Express 1.0 is coming out on June 10th. After years of hard work we are so happy to be at the finish line and get the full game into your hands!

Check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223160/Apocalypse_Express/?curator_clanid=45993102

Ride through the remains of the world on your trusty locomotive! Conduct, Repair, Gather, Manage and Fight through endless waves of enemies as they try to stop you in your tracks!

Experiment with hundreds of builds and combinations of modules and upgrades! Expand your toolkit with various enhancements that you will unlock as you play!

Join our discord for more updates: https://discord.gg/5H8Vnacakz
